corrected_fields.summary: This Federal Reserve document (October 2025, updated January 2026) provides technical documentation on credit risk models used in the 2026 Supervisory Stress Test. It covers seven model categories: Corporate, Commercial Real Estate, First Lien Mortgage, Home Equity, Credit Card, Auto, and Other Retail. The January 2026 revision added transparency on model coefficients and made technical corrections.
